description: List pull requests in a repository

creatorId.description: Filter by creator ID (must be a UUID string)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

reviewerId.description: Filter by reviewer ID (must be a UUID string)

skip.description: Number of pull requests to skip for pagination

top.description: Maximum number of pull requests to return (default: 10)

name: list_pull_requests
